name: Client report pack
summary: Pulls each client's numbers for the last full month, drafts the client report in Gmail once the account manager has written the commentary, and queues the send for approval. Crons read and draft; a person approves every send.

covered_by.report-trigger: pull (runs daily and takes the last full month)
covered_by.add-commentary: skill (writes the commentary the draft waits for)
covered_by.internal-review: approval (the person reads the Gmail draft before it is sent)
covered_by.record-keeping: draft (report record in the workflow store)

crons.name: pull
crons.summary: Read last month's numbers for each client from Supermetrics. Reads only.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Build each client's report once its commentary is written, put it in Gmail as a draft, and queue its send for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads of client numbers, and a Gmail draft that a person still has to send. Sending the draft is a live operation and waits for a person.

supermetrics.covers: pull-data: one getData query per client for the month, from the Supermetrics spec

google-workspace.covers: the client report as a Gmail draft, and its approved send

gaps: Agency Analytics and Reportz have no platform in the kit and no operations mapped. Clients who report from them need their numbers in Supermetrics, or a platform mapping added to the kit.
The Supermetrics export operation in the evidence (exportTableGroup) returns a data model, not numbers, so it is not used.
Commentary is judgment. No command yet writes it into the workflow store, so the draft cron waits until a store write exists (a runtime change, not made here).
Check-data (cross-source reconciliation) is not built. The vendor docs describe anomaly alerts only.
Client questions and action-item tracking are not built. Agency Analytics describes a client login and goal alerts, not a task tracker.
The trend view the owner asked for has no fitting solution yet. A trend read would be a skill, not a cron.
Every adapter is docs-only until a sandbox Supermetrics account and a Google Workspace test mailbox prove it.
